path_contract: All file and directory paths are relative to the workspace root. Absolute paths and escapes are rejected.

rules: Never encode blocked, empty and failed as the same empty string.
Do not return stack traces, secrets or unrestricted raw content.
Include truncation and pagination metadata when applicable.
Provider refusal and provider unavailability are failed; only harness policy, grant, validation or limit decisions are blocked.

model_tools.name: read_file
model_tools.description: Reads a range from an existing text file. Use when the file is already known. Do not use it to find files; use glob.

file_path.description: Path relative to the workspace root. Absolute paths and paths outside the workspace are rejected.

max_lines.description: Maximum number of lines to return. Lines, not items and not characters: limit means a count of items everywhere it appears, and this argument is named apart because it does not measure one.

executor_invariants: A successful result includes content_sha256 so later write_file or edit calls can use an optimistic-concurrency precondition.
The result states whether it was truncated and how to request the next range.

model_tools.name: write_file
model_tools.description: Creates a text file or replaces its complete contents. Use only when the full desired content is known. Replacing an existing file requires its current SHA-256 precondition.

file_path.description: Path relative to the workspace root. Absolute paths and paths outside the workspace are rejected.

expected_current_sha256.description: Required when replacing an existing file. The write fails if the current bytes do not match this SHA-256.

executor_invariants: Creating a missing file does not require expected_current_sha256.
Replacing an existing file requires expected_current_sha256.
After an HTML write, page verification is controlled by config/harness.json and is not model-selectable.

model_tools.name: edit
model_tools.description: Replaces an inclusive line range in an existing text file. Use for a localized change. The edit requires the current file SHA-256 and fails on stale content.

file_path.description: Path relative to the workspace root. Absolute paths and paths outside the workspace are rejected.

start_line.description: First line to replace, one-based and inclusive.

end_line.description: Last line to replace, one-based and inclusive. Must be greater than or equal to start_line.

replacement.description: Exact UTF-8 replacement text. Whitespace and final newlines are significant.

expected_current_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the current file bytes. The edit fails if it does not match.

executor_invariants: end_line must be greater than or equal to start_line.
The runtime parser must pass byte-for-byte whitespace round-trip tests before this tool is enabled.

model_tools.name: list_directory
model_tools.description: Lists immediate entries in a known directory. Do not use it for recursive filename matching; use glob.

directory_path.description: Directory path relative to the workspace root. Use . for the workspace root.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return.

model_tools.name: glob
model_tools.description: Finds file and directory paths by glob pattern. Use it to locate names, not to search file contents.

pattern.description: Glob pattern evaluated inside the workspace, with standard glob semantics: a plain pattern such as *.md matches only the chosen directory, and ** is required to descend into subdirectories.

directory_path.description: Directory path relative to the workspace root.

limit.description: Maximum number of paths to return.

model_tools.name: grep_search
model_tools.description: Searches text or a regular expression inside workspace files. Use it for content, not for filename discovery; use glob for paths.

pattern.description: Text or regular expression to search for.

directory_path.description: Directory path relative to the workspace root.

is_regex.description: When true, pattern is a regular expression.

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return.

model_tools.name: web_search
model_tools.description: Searches the public web to discover current pages. Use web_fetch when the exact URL is already known.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

model_tools.name: web_fetch
model_tools.description: Fetches readable content from a known public URL. The executor chooses HTTP or a browser internally. Do not use it to discover URLs; use web_search.

url.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS URL. Private, local, reserved and disallowed redirect targets are rejected.

max_chars.description: Maximum number of extracted characters to return. Characters, not results: a number that suits web_search means nothing here. The cut is made from the top of the page, and a page usually opens with navigation, notices and an infobox before any prose, so lowering this drops the article and keeps the noise. Leave it at the default unless the page is known to be short.

executor_invariants: Resolve and enforce SSRF policy before connecting and after every redirect.
HTTP is attempted first; browser escalation is internal and symptom-driven.
HTML extraction is shared and runs once before the result enters the model view.

model_tools.name: corpus_search
model_tools.description: Searches the Corpus the Operator selected for this conversation and returns verbatim passages with their provenance. The first passages were already retrieved before this step: use this only to search again with different terms.

query.description: What to look for. Write it as a standalone question or phrase; earlier turns are not visible to the search.

limit.description: Maximum number of passages to return.

executor_invariants: Passages are returned verbatim, with the Document title, the heading path and the page when the source has one; the retrieval never paraphrases or translates stored text.
A passage collected from the web carries UntrustedWebTaint and the result declares the union of the taints it returned.
Nothing above the relevance floor is empty, never a passage returned to fill the answer.

model_tools.name: calculate
model_tools.description: Evaluates one arithmetic expression exactly. Reads nothing, writes nothing and reaches no network.

expression.description: Arithmetic expression using numbers, + - * / // % ** and parentheses.

executor_invariants: The expression is parsed into an AST and only arithmetic nodes are evaluated; no name, call or attribute is ever resolved.

model_tools.name: get_weather
model_tools.description: Reports current weather and the daily forecast for a place, resolving the place name to coordinates first.

location.description: Place name, optionally with region or country, such as "Recife, Brazil".

days.description: How many forecast days to return, starting today.

model_tools.name: describe_image
model_tools.description: Asks a local vision model one question about a PNG, JPEG or WebP image in the workspace and returns its answer. Use it when the Operator refers to a screenshot, photo, receipt or chart file. The reading can be wrong on small text and digits.

file_path.description: Image path relative to the workspace root. Absolute paths and paths outside the workspace are rejected.

question.description: What to find in the image, as a specific question, e.g. 'What is the total on this receipt?'.

executor_invariants: The image is size-checked before a byte is read and identified by magic bytes, not by extension.
Image bytes never enter the result, telemetry or CanonicalHistory; the result carries the answer, a fixed caveat and the image digest, size, format and dimensions.

prohibited_capabilities.name: run_shell_command
prohibited_capabilities.reason: Shell execution is excluded from the first release threat model.

prohibited_capabilities.name: code_interpreter
prohibited_capabilities.reason: Arbitrary code execution is excluded from the first release threat model.

prohibited_capabilities.name: verify_page
prohibited_capabilities.reason: Page verification is InternalAutomation and cannot be selected by the model.

prohibited_capabilities.name: browser
prohibited_capabilities.reason: Browser use is InternalAutomation behind guarded web_fetch and page verification.

prohibited_capabilities.name: web_extractor
prohibited_capabilities.reason: HTML extraction is InternalAutomation in the context layer.

prohibited_capabilities.name: display_image
prohibited_capabilities.reason: Showing an image to the Operator is UI, not a model tool; describe_image only reads.

prohibited_capabilities.name: remote_model
prohibited_capabilities.reason: Remote model egress is not available in the first release.
